sentences: Pepto-Bismol is a brand name for a medication that contains the active ingredient bismuth subsalicylate
It is commonly used to treat temporary discomforts of the stomach and gastrointestinal tract, such as nausea, heartburn, indigestion, upset stomach, and diarrhea
